long_description:
Come celebrate Diwali- the festival of lights with Drinks First, the best way to meet new people in NYC. This event is open to singles, non singles, **and everyone in and out of the South Asian community**.

This year we are taking over ALL of the Moxy Williamsburg for our biggest Diwali yet: Lillistar, The Garden, Bar Bedford, and Jolene Sound Room!

Sounds all night long by 444, DJ Halla, DJ Sharad, Firungi, Vikmatic (vinyl), and live performances by Shevya and Vy.

Specialty cocktails by Kolkata Chai Co, late night eats by Chaat Dog. Henna by Axa and Arsh.

DRESS CODE: Feel free to wear indo/indowestern clothes but come in whatever you feel festive in!

**Entry**

Free entry before 10:30pm, ID (21+).

Any entry after 10:30pm is ticketed.

Entry will be at doorman discretion.

To buy a table please email aGVsbG8gfCBkcmlua3NmaXJzdCAhIGNv

**Photography and Filming Consent:**

Please note that this event will be filmed and photographed. By attending, you expressly consent to photography and filming, and for this media to be used by Drinks First for social media, marketing, internal use, and other purposes. Data and media from the event will be shared with all parties involved. By requesting to attend the event you are giving us your enthusiastic consent to be in any and all media. **Please do not attend if you are not comfortable with this.**

**Liability Disclaimer**

Please be aware that by attending this event, you acknowledge and agree that Drinks First is not liable for any injuries, accidents, or health issues that may occur during the event. While we strive to provide a safe and enjoyable environment, participation is at your own risk.

**Safety**

All Drinks First events are inclusive of gender, sexuality, race, and ability. Any form of discrimination will not be tolerated. Drinks First is not liable for any damage, theft, or violation that occurs at the event- for security issues, please contact venue.

**Data**

All sign up/rsvp information will be shared
